cues: The pair the board loves most.
The teacher entered the class; the students stood up.
Put the earlier event after no sooner, in the past perfect, and invert: no sooner had the teacher entered the class.
Then join with than, never then: than the students stood up.
With hardly or scarcely, the second half takes when: hardly had the teacher entered the class when the students stood up.
